name: Hurricane, 4 km
line: The same hurricane on a 4 km grid: a tighter eye than the 8 km quick look. Not compared with CM1 at 4 km.
note: This is CM1's hurricane case run with GM1's physics choices, not CM1's stock hurricane: an even 4 km grid over 1024 km in place of CM1's stretched one, GM1's turbulence scheme in place of a boundary layer scheme, a constant ocean drag, and 250 cloud droplets per cubic centimetre. What you will see: rain cells ring the swirl in the first day, it tightens on the second, and the eye is clear by hour 48, smaller than the 8 km quick look draws it. GM1's run of this preset on an RTX 4090 with ArWen 2.8.9 (gpuwm 2.8.9) ran its whole 4 days: 989.6 hPa and 37.8 m/s ground-relative at the lowest level at hour 48, 965.6 hPa and 58.5 m/s ground-relative at hour 72, and 965.5 hPa and 52.4 m/s ground-relative at hour 96; it was strongest at hour 90, with 952.3 hPa and 69.9 m/s ground-relative (measured). The run with ArWen 2.8.0 (gpuwm 2.8.0) ended at 958.7 hPa and 61.8 m/s ground-relative. CM1 has not been run with these settings at 4 km, so this storm has nothing to be compared with. The time step is a fixed 7.5 s where CM1's file has one that changes with the storm. With CM1's own adaptive setting GM1's hurricane stops early or makes a much weaker storm, a known issue: 8 km runs on it stopped at hour 20.8 and at hour 29.1, and the one that ran to the end reached 995 hPa and 35 m/s ground-relative where CM1 reaches 955 hPa and 62 m/s ground-relative (measured with ArWen 2.8.0 (gpuwm 2.8.0)).

floors_why: A hurricane is not made smaller than 1000 km across, because its starting swirl is 500 km in radius, or shorter than 3 days, because its eye is not clear before the end of the second day.

eye_forms.basis: GM1's run of this preset on an RTX 4090 with ArWen 2.8.9 (gpuwm 2.8.9) has a clear eye by hour 48 (measured); CM1 has not been run with these settings at 4 km
